en: Black‑and‑white seaside view of the promenade and beach at Eforie Nord on the Black Sea. People walk along a paved clifftop walkway while others are on the sand and in the water. Caption at top left reads "EFORIE‑NORD — Pe faleză." The back shows Romanian printings such as "REPUBLICA POPULARA ROMINA," "CARTE POSTALA," publisher Editura Meridiane, a 40‑bani "R. P. ROMINA" stamp canceled in Constanța/București (1963), and a handwritten message.
